# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v3 c39 P25](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0025)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher

## Appearance

Jane is a placid, pink-cheeked woman with a fat paw. Her appearance is simple and plain compared to others, but she is described as wholesome and neat.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is placid, amiable, and practical, lacking a strong imagination or brilliant wit. She never says anything to hurt anyone's feelings, possessing a rare negative talent for gentle kindness. While pragmatic and matter-of-fact, she remains unspooled by wealth and sympathizes deeply with her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v3 c31 P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

- Excellent cooking  <sub>[v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)</sub>

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea as part of a close-knit group of friends alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis. In her youth, she participated in dramatic play with her friends, though her practical nature often made her hesitant during their imaginative antics. She later became a schoolteacher. Jane eventually became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman who made a fortune in mines, and married him in a splendid wedding before setting off on a honeymoon tour of Europe. Following her marriage, she went to live in Winnipeg, remaining sweet, unpretentious, and deeply attached to her old Avonlea friends.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_
